parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['rep_name','deals','commission_plan'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const deals=Array.isArray(body.deals)?body.deals:[];if(deals.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'deals must be non-empty'}}];const plan=body.commission_plan||{};const baseRate=parseFloat(plan.base_rate)||0.1;const quota=parseFloat(plan.quota)||null;const accelerators=Array.isArray(plan.accelerators)?plan.accelerators:[];const currency=body.currency||'USD';const formattedDeals=deals.slice(0,60).map((d,i)=>({id:d.id||('DEAL-'+String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')),name:(d.name||'').trim(),amount:parseFloat(d.amount)||0,closeDate:d.close_date||'',dealType:d.deal_type||'new_business',dealTypeMultiplier:parseFloat(d.deal_type_multiplier)||1}));const totalBookings=formattedDeals.reduce((s,d)=>s+d.amount,0);const attainmentPct=quota?parseFloat(((totalBookings/quota)*100).toFixed(2)):null;let applicableRate=baseRate;let appliedAccelerator=null;if(accelerators.length&&attainmentPct!==null){const sorted=[...accelerators].sort((a,b)=>parseFloat(b.attainment_threshold_pct)-parseFloat(a.attainment_threshold_pct));for(const acc of sorted){if(attainmentPct>=parseFloat(acc.attainment_threshold_pct)){applicableRate=parseFloat(acc.rate);appliedAccelerator=acc;break;}}}const dealCalcs=formattedDeals.map(d=>({...d,commission:parseFloat((d.amount*applicableRate*d.dealTypeMultiplier).toFixed(2))}));const totalCommission=parseFloat(dealCalcs.reduce((s,d)=>s+d.commission,0).toFixed(2));return[{json:{valid:true,repName:body.rep_name.trim(),period:(body.period||'').trim(),currency,baseRate,quota,totalBookings:parseFloat(totalBookings.toFixed(2)),attainmentPct,applicableRate,appliedAccelerator,dealCalcs,dealCount:dealCalcs.length,totalCommission,accelerators,replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];
